BiblicalUsage: Here is sâdeh: it means a field (as flat). It stands in 1 Chronicles 1:46, "…dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote…", and in 1 Kings 2:26, "…Lord GOD before David my father, and because…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that sâdeh counts, because God put it in his book.
